description: This file contains a shell script function for performing a failsafe data check during an upgrade process in U-Boot environments. It calculates and verifies image sizes, offsets, and checksums for kernel and root filesystem images, then updates environment variables and performs the upgrade steps.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_failsafe_datachk
methods.description: Main function that performs the data check, updates environment variables, and handles the firmware upgrade process.
